name: LeetSwap WETH/BRIAN pair fee-transfer drain
summary: LeetSwapV2Pair exposed its fee-transfer helper publicly without caller, token, or amount authorization. An unprivileged caller could move a pair's counterpart-token balance into its fees contract, synchronize the depleted reserve, and drain WETH through the resulting reserve distortion.

loss.notes: The pair sent 11.360785525333188388 WETH to the attack helper. Excluding the helper's identifiable 0.001 WETH setup-swap input leaves exact pre-recovery victim depletion of 11.359785525333188388 WETH, valued at DefiLlama's nearest observation of $1,862.36. The public fee-transfer call also moved the counterpart token into the pair's fees contract; that internal transfer is excluded because claim allocation and recoverability cannot be isolated from the receipts, so no speculative counterpart-token value is assigned.

ageReset.description: LeetSwap factory CREATE2 deployment of this immutable-bearing pair runtime. Archival code is absent in block 1967089 and hashes to 0x0f5ef9c858ac6a18a8ba1bec9eb648a6229cdf205a409108c6ace9e97f6bb85b at deployment and immediately before the incident; the pair has no proxy code-selection path.

sources.note: Campaign boundary: calldata enumeration of the original EOA's successful transactions shows 0x5005ac22398b82d22d89f3f4e55ebf62bb2e437b21482c0de581f69b1cdb6a94 is the sole defect-executing drain transaction against pair 0x83cd3371e01db36ea760d2541ab397de39793ad9; other LeetSwap pair deployments are separate records with separate losses and ages. Verified LeetSwapV2Pair source exposes _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens(address,uint256) as a public function with no caller, token, or amount authorization. The transaction trace calls it for the counterpart-token balance, calls sync(), and then swaps the setup tokens for WETH at the corrupted reserves. Code history: factory 0x169c06b4cfb09bfd73a81e6f2bb1eb514d75bb19 CREATE2-deployed the pair in 0x00d6982ab87ab4e27af83fadb4df4ac4e5afc05cfb859e2b42133a893f7f19c5 at block 1967090:10; archival code is empty in the preceding block and the immutable-bearing direct runtime hashes to 0x0f5ef9c858ac6a18a8ba1bec9eb648a6229cdf205a409108c6ace9e97f6bb85b at creation and before the anchor. Loss: receipt Transfer logs show exactly 11.360785525333188388 WETH leaving this pair for helper 0xea8f89f47f3d4293897b4fe8cb69b5c233b9f560. The counterpart-token transfer goes to the pair's own fees contract and is not valued because its claim allocation/recoverability is not isolated.

notes: This pair-specific record is part of a coordinated same-attacker LeetSwap umbrella. Loss is partitioned by pair deployment and is not duplicated across sibling records.
